story.title:
Remember When
Everyone Carried One?
story.subtitle: Carrying a handkerchief was once a normal everyday habit. It was practical, personal, hygienic, and reflected care for oneself and others.
paragraphs: A handkerchief was in every pocket, purse, and school bag. It wiped away tears, dried hands after washing, dabbed a child's forehead in the sun, and stood ready for unexpected moments of warmth.
Somewhere along the way, we replaced this thoughtful, permanent companion with single-use paper tissues. We sacrificed dignity, craftsmanship, and sustainability for temporary convenience.
SQUCO exists to revive this lost daily habit — making carrying a soft, clean handkerchief second nature for adults, executives, couples, and little ones alike.

principles.convictionText: SQUCO is built on a simple conviction: a clean, soft handkerchief is a quiet companion of poise, personal hygiene, and human warmth. We craft every handkerchief from 100% organic cotton, handloom weaves, and signature gold-embossed forest green presentation boxes so that carrying a handkerchief feels natural, modern, and deeply rewarding.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about SQUCO handkerchiefs, organic cotton care, and direct WhatsApp ordering.

items.q: Why carry a handkerchief when we have paper tissues?
items.a: Paper tissues are single-use, bleach-processed, and generate massive daily waste that ends up in landfills. A SQUCO organic cotton handkerchief is soft on skin, completely reusable, washable hundreds of times, and adds timeless poise and personal care to your day.

items.q: How do I care for and wash my SQUCO handkerchiefs?
items.a: Machine wash or hand wash with gentle detergent. Warm ironing restores crisp edges. Our 100% organic cotton and handloom weaves become softer and more absorbent with each wash cycle.

items.q: How do I order on WhatsApp?
items.a: Simply click any 'Order on WhatsApp' button on the website. A pre-filled order query will open directly in your WhatsApp app with your chosen product collection, ready for direct assistance and delivery.

items.q: Can I customize handkerchief sets for corporate gifting or weddings?
items.a: Yes! We specialize in custom embroidered initials, corporate logo branding, wedding return gift boxes, and bespoke festive packaging. Reach out to us directly on WhatsApp at 9019921521.
